name: Noah
overview: Scripture presents Noah as a righteous man who found grace in the eyes of the Lord, faithfully obeying God's commands by building the ark as instructed (Genesis 6:8-9, 6:14, 6:22). He is introduced as the son of Lamech, whose name signifies comfort amid a cursed ground, highlighting God's mercy in a fallen world (Genesis 5:28-29). Noah's walk with God and his obedience exemplify faithfulness, setting the stage for God's covenant promise symbolized by the rainbow after the flood.
